name: project-alpha
description: Helper npm scripts for running preprocessing and training tasks

scripts.parquet: python preprocessing/test/describe_parquet.py --input data/preprocessed/fast/20240610.parquet --output preprocessing/test/parquet-output.txt && python preprocessing/test/describe_parquet.py --input data/preprocessed/20240610.parquet --output preprocessing/test/parquet-labels-output.txt
scripts.packages: python -m pip install -r training/requirements.txt && python -m pip install -r deployment/requirements.txt
scripts.realtime: cd preprocessing && cargo run --bin realtime -- --resolutions fast,mid,slow --source C:/Ninjatrader/L2Log.txt --emit ../runs/realtime/features.jsonl --norm-state-dir ../data/preprocessed/.checkpoints/normalization/latest --session-gap-secs 900
scripts.deployment: cd deployment && python realtime_inference.py --model-bundle ../runs/models/best_model.pt --features ../runs/realtime/features.jsonl --resolutions fast mid slow --trade-threshold 0.90 --entry-price-feature mid_close_price --trigger-log-file ../runs/deployment/trade_triggers.jsonl --eval-trades-jsonl ../runs/deployment/trades.jsonl --pause-min-start 930 --pause-min-end 1080
scripts.evaluation: cargo build --manifest-path preprocessing/Cargo.toml && python evaluation/realtime_eval.py --sweep-config-yaml evaluation/sweep_config.yaml --keep-features
